ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast bimodal distribution; dark pixels (low-intensity) occupy approximately 70% of the visible surface, primarily in the central and basal regions, while white pixels (high-intensity) occupy approximately 30% at the distal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous low-intensity dark mass concentrated in the lower central fluke. Distal upper lobes contain large, high-intensity white patches. Transition zones between regions exhibit high-frequency salt-and-pepper mottling and small localized dark blobs within the white regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped median notch with a calculated interior angle of approximately 55 degrees; the notch apex exhibits high pixel depth relative to the fluke width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serration along the entire trailing edge boundary. Variations exhibit pixel-amplitudes between 5 and 25 pixels, with the highest density of jagged peaks located near the distal lobe tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Outer margins exhibit a concave sweep from the waterline, transitioning into a strong convex curve as the edge reaches the lateral distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular and semi-circular high-intensity white clusters (3-8 pixels in diameter) detected on the dark pigmented surfaces of both the left and right lobes, consistent with barnacle scar residue.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several faint, unaligned vertical linear pixel disruptions (white against dark) are visible on the mid-section of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent, distinct white annular (ring-shaped) scar located in the dark region of the right lobe. Irregular, non-uniform jagged notches on the right lobe's trailing edge suggesting prior mechanical trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly unique, high-contrast circular 'O-ring' mark on the right fluke; localized high-intensity pixel splash along the very base where the fluke meets the water line.
